item.title: [LU-20423] TBF: fix the wrong TBF class bucket when check its state bit in LRU
item.description:
In nrs_tbf_cli_findadd(), when found a class bucket form rhashtable but with refcount of 0, it should continue to check whether it is in LRU. But the implementation uses the wrong class bucket for the check.

static struct nrs_tbf_client *                                                  
nrs_tbf_cli_findadd(struct nrs_tbf_head *head,                                  
                    struct nrs_tbf_client *cli)                                 
{                                                                               
        struct nrs_tbf_client *cli2 = NULL;                                     
                                                                                
try_again:                                                                      
        rcu_read_lock();                                                        
        cli2 = rhashtable_lookup_get_insert_fast(&head->th_cli_rhash,           
                                                 &cli->tc_rhash,                
                                                 head->th_rhash_params);        
        if (IS_ERR(cli2))                                                       
                goto out;                                                       
                                                                                
        if (cli2 && !refcount_inc_not_zero(&cli2->tc_ref)) {                    
                cli2 = nrs_tbf_lru_tryhit(head, cli); ==> "cli" -> "cli2"                          
                if (!cli2) {                                                    
                        /* lost race -> retry */                                
                        rcu_read_unlock();                                      
                        schedule();                                             
                        goto try_again;                                         
                }                                                               
        }

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment:
Moreover, I doubt there should be some racing bug in nrs_tbf_lru_shrink():

rcu_read_lock();                                                        
        list_for_each_entry_rcu(cli, &head->th_lru_list, tc_lru) {              
                if (atomic_read(&head->th_lru_cnt) <= low)                      
                        break;                                                  
                                                                                
                /* race with nrs_tbf_lru_tryhit()/nrs_tbf_lru_add ? */          
                if (!test_and_clear_bit(NRS_TBF_CLI_LRU_BIT, &cli->tc_state))   
                        continue;                                               
                                                                                
                LASSERTF(!refcount_read(&cli->tc_ref), "class@%p ref != 0: %d", 
                         cli, refcount_read(&cli->tc_ref));                     
                                                                                
                rhashtable_remove_fast(&head->th_cli_rhash, &cli->tc_rhash,     
                                       head->th_rhash_params);                  
                                                                                
                spin_lock(&head->th_lru_lock);                                  
                atomic_dec(&head->th_lru_cnt);                                  
                list_del_rcu(&cli->tc_lru);                                     
                spin_unlock(&head->th_lru_lock);                                
                                                                                
                nrs_tbf_cli_fini(cli);                                          
                freed++;                                                        
        }                                                                       
        rcu_read_unlock();

we remove the class bucket in the read RCU lock, it may race with nrs_tbf_lru_add()?

we remove the class bucket in the read RCU lock, it may race with nrs_tbf_lru_add()?

Could you elaborate on your thoughts? What race are you referring to?
This comment explains how handle the race to add/delete/shrink the TBF LRU:

/* The following nrs_tbf_lru_* function manipulate class object with a 0
 * refcount. These need to be accessed with a rcu lock to prevent deletions.
 * A TBF class with a 0 refcount means the following things:
 *  - class is in LRU list (NRS_TBF_CLI_LRU_BIT is set)
 *  - class is being added in LRU (refs 1->0 then NRS_TBF_CLI_LRU_BIT 0->1)
 *  - class is being deleted (NRS_TBF_CLI_LRU_BIT 1->0)
 *  - class is being removed from LRU (NRS_TBF_CLI_LRU_BIT 1->0 then refs 0->1)
 */

So to add a class in LRU the ref was > 0 and the flag NRS_TBF_CLI_LRU_BIT not set, this should not race with the shrink process ref = 0 and NRS_TBF_CLI_LRU_BIT set. The race window between test_and_clear_bit(NRS_TBF_CLI_LRU_BIT,..) and rhashtable_remove_fast() should not exist.

static void
nrs_tbf_cli_put(struct nrs_tbf_head *head, struct nrs_tbf_client *cli)
{

	if (!refcount_dec_and_test(&cli->tc_ref))
		return;

	nrs_tbf_lru_add(head, cli);
	nrs_tbf_lru_shrink(head);
}
